notes: Pilot Dark E-field Radio experiment at UC Davis searching for dark photon dark matter via kinetic mixing, 50-300 MHz (~0.2-1.2 ueV). The paper presents measured 5-sigma exclusion limits: epsilon ~ 1e-12 across 50-300 MHz from 3.8 hours of broadband scanning (Fig. 9, encoded as a flat two-point band since only the approximate level is given in text), plus a spot-frequency 5-sigma limit of epsilon = 6.4e-13 at 70.5 MHz from a 1e6 s narrow-band integration. Additional spot checks at 63.9, 152, and 247 MHz were made but exact values only appear in figures. Phase-I (eps~1e-13) and Phase-II projections are NOT included as data points since measured pilot limits exist. Local DM density assumed 380+/-180 TeV/m^3 (~0.38 GeV/cm^3). Paper quotes 5-sigma limits, not 90/95% CL; 0.95 entered as closest allowed value.
